cards.lore: Lacks the Brown-Fat-Battery. Brain prone to IVH-the-Blood (fragile germinal matrix).
cards.power: The Transparency-Armor. Paul loses heat and water at record pace due to paper-thin skin.

cards.lore: Prevents Hyaline Membrane Disease. We must spray Liquid-Lung-Shield into the pipes.
cards.power: The Anti-Collapse. Reduces surface tension. Prevents the Alveolar-Balloons from snapping shut.

cards.lore: Prostaglandins keep it open. Use Indo-the-Lock to shut the gate.
cards.power: The Lung-Flooder. Fails to close, shunting blood from Aorta-Highway back into lungs.

cards.lore: Triggered by Ischemia and Naive-Gut feeds. Requires Bowel-Rest and Antibiotic-Artillery.
cards.power: The Gut-Eroder. Bacterial rot in the immature gut leading to Belly-Burst.

cards.lore: Positive pressure prevents alveolar collapse, delaying the Vandal-Ventilator.
cards.power: The Constant-Open. Splints pipes open so the Knight doesn't fight for every breath.

cards.lore: Preemies have an immature respiratory center. Caffeine increases CO2 sensitivity.
cards.power: The Breathing-Reminder. Tells the Brain-Stem-Clock to keep ticking.

cards.lore: Causes air-trapping and persistent pulmonary hypertension (PPHN).
cards.power: The Sticky-Invasion. The Knight breathes his first Poop, causing a Chemical-Fire.

cards.lore: The Alveolar-Balloons become scarred. The heavy price of early survival.
cards.power: The Chronic-Stiff-Lung. The toll taken when the Vandal-Ventilator damages developing lungs.

cards.lore: Common in ELBW. Grade 3/4 leads to Hydrocephalus-the-Pressure.
cards.power: The Basement-Flood. Fragile vessels burst, spilling blood into the brain's Water-Rooms.

cards.lore: needs Cool-the-Cap-Therapy to slow cellular decay.
cards.power: The Oxygen-Blackout. Occurs when the Oxygen-Line is cut during birth. Brain-Power-Failure.

cards.lore: Caused by pressure drops. The motor wiring literally melts away.
cards.power: The Wiring-Damage. Destroys White-Matter-Cables, destroying future Motor-Mines.

cards.lore: A surface symptom of underlying HIE or metabolic Stat errors.
cards.power: The Electrical-Glitch. Can be silent—just Lip-Smacking or Bicycling-Legs.

cards.lore: If Bili crosses the blood-brain barrier: Kernicterus (permanent damage).
cards.power: The Skin-Stainer. The Liver-Factory is too slow to process red cell breakdown.

cards.lore: Hyperinsulinism in utero leads to a massive crash when the cord is cut.
cards.power: The Energy-Crash. Common in infants of diabetic mothers cut off from the High-Sugar-Stream.

cards.lore: Requires the Silo-Bag-Squeeze to slowly coax the organs back inside.
cards.power: The Exposed-Gut. Intestines are born Outside the body, naked and angry.

cards.lore: High risk of associated genetic Gaps (Beckwith-Wiedemann).
cards.power: The Protected-Hernia. Outside the body, but protected inside a Safety-Bag.

cards.lore: Needs Intrapartum Antibiotic Prophylaxis (IAP) at weeks 35-37.
cards.power: The Silent-Sepsis. Hides in the birth canal and ambushes the newborn.

cards.lore: CMV is the leading cause of non-genetic hearing loss.
cards.power: The Womb-Sabotage. Attacks the Knight before birth, causing Small-Size and Brain-Scars.

cards.lore: Invades after Antibiotic-Artillery slaughters the Good-Guard-Bacteria.
cards.power: The Fungal-Clog. Makes feeding painful and skin raw.

cards.lore: High meningitis risk. Deploy the Amp-and-Gent-Guards.
cards.power: The Total-Body-Shutdown. Newborns don't get fevers; they get Quiet-and-Grey.

cards.lore: Prevents devastating Transepidermal Water Loss (TEWL).
cards.power: The Artificial-Womb. Keeps the Knight Warm-and-Wet to conserve vital energy.

cards.lore: Must verify tip placement on X-ray before use.
cards.power: The Direct-Highway. Immediate central access for High-Concentration-TPN and pressure.

cards.lore: Unlike manual self-inflating bags, the Neopuff guarantees consistent PEEP.
cards.power: The Gentle-Inflation. Provides exact pressure without Vandalizing the delicate lungs.

cards.lore: Protect the Knight's eyes from the Blue-Blaster.
cards.power: The Yellow-Melter. Physically transforms Bili-the-Yellow into water-soluble Lumirublin.

cards.lore: Newborns possess zero K-Storage. Without it, they bleed into the brain.
cards.power: The Blood-Blocker. Prevents Vitamin K Deficiency Bleeding (VKDB).

cards.lore: A mandatory Delivery Room buff applied to every Knight.
cards.power: The Blindness-Barrier. The first defense against Gonorrheal conjunctivitis.

cards.lore: Buys time and keeps the baby alive until the Surgical-Team arrives.
cards.power: The Life-Line-Extension. Keeps Duct-the-Persistent OPEN in cyanotic heart defects.

cards.lore: Also heavily used to prevent IVH in extremely premature babies.
cards.power: The Gate-Closer. Forces the Duct to snap shut, halting the Lung-Flood.

cards.lore: Devastating high resistance. Requires Nitric-the-Gas to relax the iron grip.
cards.power: The Valve-Reversal. Lung-pipes clamp shut, forcing blood to completely skip the lungs.

cards.lore: Targeted cGMP-activation. The ultimate weapon against PPHN.
cards.power: The Pipe-Opener. Selectively relaxes the pipes only in the lungs, not the systemic host.

cards.lore: Deployed when the baby's own Adrenal Factory is too immature to mount a stress response.
cards.power: The Vessel-Sensitizer. Primes the heart and pipes to finally hear adrenaline signals.

cards.lore: The first-line pressor deployed in many NICUs to fight Hypotension-the-Hollow.
cards.power: The Pump-Beast. Mechanically drives blood pressure up when the Micro-heart fails.

cards.lore: Usually left-sided (Bochdalek). Lung hypoplasia is the true killer, not the hernia itself.
cards.power: The Space-Occupier. The gut invades the chest, brutally squashing the Lung-Balloons.

cards.lore: Associated with VACTERL. Food dumps to lungs, air dumps to stomach.
cards.power: The Pipe-Mixer. The Food-Pipe and Wind-Pipe are dangerously soldered together.

cards.lore: Crying forces open the Mouth-Gate, bypassing the blocked nose temporarily.
cards.power: The Nose-Block. Newborns are obligate nose breathers. Blocked nose = choking until crying.

cards.lore: Aganglionic segment causes everything upstream to balloon into a Mega-Colon.
cards.power: The Nerve-Gap. A segment of colon is missing Neural-Drivers, remaining completely Static.

cards.lore: The First-Vaccine. The ultimate defense against Necro-the-Entero.
cards.power: The Immune-Primer. Paints the Gut-Gate with antibodies.

cards.lore: Preemies miss the 3rd-trimester Nutrient-Dump and require massive extra caloric supply.
cards.power: The Growth-Boost. Mimics the Placental-Feed with hyper-dense protein and calcium.

cards.lore: Pure chemical fuel essential for building the brain and bones of ELBW knights.
cards.power: The Bypass-Fuel. When the gut is offline, the blood directly carries the food.

cards.lore: Osteopenia of Prematurity. Requires aggressive high-dose mineral supplementation.
cards.power: The Skeleton-Sag. Without womb-level calcium, the bones turn to soft rubber.

cards.lore: Must initiate within 6 hours of birth to save the Knight's brain.
cards.power: The Chemical-Freeze. Slows metabolic time to halt Excitotoxicity in the brain.

cards.lore: A brutal trade: sacrifices peripheral vision to guarantee central vision.
cards.power: The Vessel-Burner. Destroys Wild Vessels before they can peel the retina off.

cards.lore: The mechanical fix when Hydrocephalus forces the skull to expand too fast.
cards.power: The Pressure-Release. Manually vents blood-stained fluid from the brain to the belly.

cards.lore: The first-line behavioral defense to reduce Morphine reliance in drug-exposed babies.
cards.power: The Sensory-Shield. Dark rooms and swaddling defeat the chaotic Withdrawal-Riot.

cards.lore: Heart rate is the single most heavily weighted Stat in the score.
cards.power: The Transition-Judge. Scores whether the Knight is winning the brutal fight to breathe air.

cards.lore: The universal Gold-Standard screen for critical congenital heart defects.
cards.power: The Shunt-Detector. A numerical gap proves blood is skipping the lungs via the Duct.

cards.lore: The simplest, fastest check that universally saves eyes and lives.
cards.power: The Vision-Guard. If the reflex bounces back white, Retino-the-White-Reflex is hiding inside.

cards.lore: Executed precisely at 24-48 hours of life to prevent permanent brain damage.
cards.power: The Hidden-Glitches-Finder. Sweeps the blood for metabolic errors before symptoms hit.

cards.lore: A classic trap for Small-for-Gestational-Age (SGA) Knights.
cards.power: The Sludge-Flow. Blood becomes so dense it physically jams the Micro-Pipes, triggering seizures or NEC.

cards.lore: Immune (Rh) or Non-immune (Heart/Parvo) triggers. Extremely high mortality.
cards.power: The Fluid-Overload. The body entirely loses fluid regulation, drowning in its own water.

cards.lore: Immature kidneys simply refuse to synthesize enough EPO until the baby ages.
cards.power: The Oxygen-Carrier Shortage. The Marrow-Factory goes on strike, halting red cell production.

cards.lore: The devastating result of missing the massive 3rd-trimester placental calcium dump.
cards.power: The Fragile-Frame. Depleted calcium/phosphorus causes bones to literally snap during routine Nappy-Changes.
